resources.string: Test vibration strength and rhythm with presets, custom timing, safe stop and local history.
Choose a rhythm and parameters, then start. Every run stops automatically after its bounded waveform and can be stopped manually.

Waveforms are limited to 30 seconds; pulses are 50–2000 ms and strength is 5–100%. Perceived intensity varies by motor, position, case and system haptics settings. This is not a medical diagnostic or safety-critical alert.
